2026_01_BUF_HOU.headline: Buffalo’s improvisation meets a Houston defense built to collapse the pocket
2026_01_BUF_HOU.paragraph1: Houston enters without a player carrying a final injury designation, while Buffalo has Ty Johnson, Jordan Hancock and T.J. Sanders listed as questionable. The larger matchup is stylistic: the Texans want their front to compress Josh Allen’s pocket and force clean, on-schedule decisions, while the Bills need completions early and then the second-reaction plays that make Allen difficult to contain. Houston’s discipline after the first read will be as important as its initial rush.
2026_01_BUF_HOU.model_rationale: Buffalo’s advantage grows when plays extend beyond the first structure, while Houston’s best route is forcing quick decisions and preventing scramble-drill explosives.
